_comment: One entry per VRAM tier. setup/detect.py picks the highest tier whose min_vram_gb fits the GPU. Only the 6gb tier has been run end to end; the others are extrapolated from it and from the tools' own documentation, so treat them as starting points and lower a setting when a job runs out of memory.

tiers.label: No supported GPU (CPU only)
tiers.summary: No NVIDIA GPU with 5.5 GB or more. The CPU-only parts still work: pixel-art grid loop and export (Aseprite), Blender clip authoring and verification, the 3D measuring tools, and the non-AI sound route. Image, 3D and audio generation are not supported here.

tiers.label: 6 GB VRAM (tested baseline, e.g. RTX 3060 Laptop)
tiers.summary: The reference machine: RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB, 16 GB RAM, Windows 11. Every default in this repo was measured here. One GPU job at a time.

moss.text_encoder: w4a8 GPTQ (7.3 GB, offloaded after encode)

sfx_ai.note: Expected 2-2.5 GB peak (paper figures); not measured on this card yet.

stablegen.note: Unproven on 6 GB. If you try it: SDXL with an fp8 UNet (ComfyUI --fp8_e4m3fn-unet) plus --lowvram, 1024 px views, one ControlNet at a time. StableGen itself asks for about 8 GB for SDXL.

tiers.label: 8 GB VRAM (extrapolated)
tiers.summary: Same models as 6 GB with more room: bigger pixel sources, the 1536 Hi3D stage, and StableGen's SDXL route becomes realistic.

stablegen.note: SDXL with an fp8 UNet (--fp8_e4m3fn-unet); StableGen's own guidance is about 8 GB for SDXL.

tiers.label: 12 GB VRAM (extrapolated)
tiers.summary: Models stay resident between jobs, batches of 4, fp16 Hi3D weights, SDXL at full precision.

moss.unet: int8 ConvRot (bf16 optional, 10.2 GB, streams from RAM)

skintokens.launch: ComfyUI with --lowvram (SkinTokens upstream asks for 14 GB without offload)

sfx_ai.model: Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX (Medium is possible: about 6.5 GB at 120 s)

tiers.label: 24 GB+ VRAM (extrapolated)
tiers.summary: Everything resident, large batches, highest precision. Still run one heavy job at a time unless you know your power supply and cooling can take more.

trellis2.weights: int8 ConvRot (bf16 if the repo offers it)

stablegen.note: SDXL fp16. Its Qwen Image route needs 16 GB+ but its licence is non-commercial (see LICENSES.md).
